$comment: Source of truth for who may open which document. Consumed by
(so a lookup can say what access a hit needs), and the KB.
ENFORCEMENT IS SERVER-SIDE ONLY. dws6.com is Cloudflare Pages with no _headers
and no Pages Functions, so its login is client-side and every file under it is
fetchable by URL. Learn/ holds the cap table, board minutes and salary data.
Never copy Learn/ under dws6.com/ and never treat a frontend check as the gate;
the gate is GET /api/v1/docs/* on dws-backend, which verifies a Supabase bearer
token before it streams a byte.
Rules are ordered and first match wins. A document matching no rule is
'confidential', so a new file is withheld until someone classifies it rather

public.description: Publishable outside Lifetime Oy — whitepapers, public product material.

customer.description: Shared with a paying customer — user manuals, customer admin manuals, product guides.

internal.description: Lifetime Oy staff — engineering and admin manuals, standards, theses, field notes.

confidential.description: Founder/board only — cap table, SAFE terms, diligence, board minutes, salary and time records.

$roleComment: Fallback for any authenticated user not named above, by organization_members.role
(migration 007). Deliberately narrow: an org owner is not automatically entitled
to founder-only material, so confidential is granted by name only.
$rulesComment: Matched against the repo-relative path, case-insensitively, in order.

rules.why: Cap table, SAFE terms, diligence, pre-term-sheet and investor Q&A.
Board minutes, salary comparison, time and invoicing records (Finnish financial appendices).
Live bid material — pricing and customer-specific commercial terms.
Whitepapers are written for external publication.
Written for customers operating the platform.
Engineering and operations material for Lifetime Oy staff.
